description: Produce a short brand film or product promo (10-60s, typically 15s) entirely as code: one static HTML page with a paused GSAP timeline that a renderer seeks frame by frame, plus a music score synthesized in Python. Use when the user wants a 品牌宣传片, 广告片, 宣传动画, 产品短片, 发布会开场视频, brand film, promo video, product teaser, logo animation, or a generated ad spot — especially when they ask for 高级感 / 艺术感 / 电影感 / 别像模板, or when an existing video "looks like AI made it" or "too simple" and needs to be redone properly. Also use when a film already exists and needs a score, a soundtrack, background music, or 配乐, or when a code-generated video needs ghosting, contrast, font, or transition defects fixed.
